messaging.heroSubtitle: Power your Relationship AI platform with seamless data pipelines. Ingest calendar, email, and CRM data from customer environments with enterprise-grade SLAs, built-in replay/backfill, and full observability.
messaging.splashSubtitle: This is where Orbb customers manage their data integrations. Connect to CRMs, calendars, and data warehouses with enterprise-grade reliability powered by SK8.

items.name: Salesforce
items.description: Ingest contact, account, and opportunity data from Salesforce to power relationship mapping.

items.name: HubSpot
items.description: Connect to HubSpot CRM to sync contacts, companies, and deal data for relationship insights.

items.name: Google Calendar
items.description: Stream calendar events and meeting data to map team relationships and engagement patterns.

items.name: Gmail
items.description: Ingest email metadata and communication patterns to enrich relationship intelligence and contact mapping.

items.name: Snowflake
items.description: Export relationship intelligence data to Snowflake for advanced analytics and reporting.

items.name: AWS S3
items.description: Store processed relationship data and exports in S3 buckets for long-term retention.

items.description: Build custom integrations via REST API endpoints or webhooks for any data source.
